task: Answer general chemistry questions concisely and correctly.
io_format: Assistant reply is exactly two lines: 'ANSWER: <short answer>' then 'WHY: <one-sentence justification>'.
success_criteria: Follows the two-line ANSWER/WHY format exactly, with no extra text
WHY is one sentence of at most 30 words
For ambiguous questions, ANSWER is a clarifying question that asks for the missing information
edge_cases: Trick or false-premise questions (the answer corrects the premise)
Ambiguous questions (ANSWER asks for the missing information)
